name: Tina
source:
A deeply tanned blond girl with green eyes. Tina always wears a two piece swimsuit. She also has a habit of levitating instead of walking. She claims this is due to a rare disease.

(from [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/925897-kakyuusei/faqs/35729]GameFAQs[/url])
